name: Weaviate Vector Store
category_description: AI cluster root node (agent, chain, vector store)
description: Use the Weaviate node to interact with your Weaviate collection as a vector store[^1]. You can insert documents into or retrieve documents from a vector database. You can also retrieve documents to provide them to a retriever connected to a chain[^2] or connect this node directly to an agent[^3] to use as a tool[^4]. On this page, you'll find the node parameters for the Weaviate node, and...

parameters.description: You can define which metadata keys you want Weaviate to return on your queries. This can reduce network load, as you will only get properties you have defined. Returns all properties from the server by default

parameters.name: Hybrid: Query Text
parameters.description: Provide a query text to combine vector search with a keyword/text search

parameters.name: Hybrid: Explain Score
parameters.description: Whether to show the score fused between hybrid and vector search explanation

parameters.name: Hybrid: Fusion Type
parameters.description: Select the fusion type for combining vector and keyword search results. Learn more about fusion algorithms
options: Relative Score: Uses relative score fusion

parameters.name: Hybrid: Auto Cut Limit
parameters.description: Limit result groups by detecting sudden jumps in score. Learn more about autocut

parameters.name: Hybrid: Alpha
parameters.description: Change the relative weights of the keyword and vector components. 1.0 = pure vector, 0.0 = pure keyword. Default is 0.5. Learn more about the alpha parameter

parameters.name: Hybrid: Query Properties
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of properties to include in the query with optionally weighted values, e.g., "question^2,answer". Learn more about setting weights on property values

parameters.name: Hybrid: Max Vector Distance
parameters.description: Set the maximum allowable distance for the vector search component

parameters.description: The specific tenant to store or retrieve documents for. Learn more about multi-tenancy

parameters.name: Text Key
parameters.description: The key in the document that contains the embedded text
